name: kelpie
description: Configurable funnel runtime with versioning, experiments, and session analytics

scripts.development: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && node scripts/development.mjs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@kelpie/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@kelpie/funnel-runtime
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && npm run build --workspace=@kelpie/backend && npm run build --workspace=@kelpie/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run configurations:verify && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run database:validate
